title: What is CLO-SET? (eCLOsystem)
content: [![CLO-SET Profile White.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776117198745)](https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus) CLO-SET is a Collaborative 3D Creation Workspace that maximizes the value of the 3D assets by bridging stages of the product life cycle in one centralized digital space. #### ### 1) Create/Prepare 3D Design Start off your CLO Virtual Fashion journey by creating your own design. Start creating your own design on the software, or download sample files from CONNECT marketplace. * Create your own 3D Design in [CLO](https://clo3d.com) or [Marvelous Designer](https://marvelousdesigner.com) software. * Prepare sample 3D files from [CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) mraketplace. ![BI_CLO_Blue.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776148489625) | ![3. Signature logo_Vertical_Shade\(Primary\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776100896409) | ![CONNECT BI Primary.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776149025689) ---|---|--- ### 2) Upload & Explore CLO-SET Once you have the 3D files ready, start uploading your files in [CLO-SET](https://style.clo-set.com). * ### Check out **Solutions** that meets your needs. For: * [Brands](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-brands) * [Manufacturers](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-manufacturers) * [Individuals](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-individuals) * ### Check out CLO-SET **Key Features** : * [3D Workspace](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#3d-workspace) * [3D Web Tech Pack](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#3d-web-tech-pack) * [Collaboration](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#collaboration) * [Cloud Rendering](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#cloud-rendering) * [Developer Tools](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#developer-tools) * [Retail & Commercial](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#retail-commercial) ### 3) Start using CLO-SET * #### [CLO-SET FAQ](https://style.clo-set.com/service/contactus) * #### [Creating an Account](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190161177) * #### [CLO-SET Pricing Plan](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) * [Start by learning how to upload files](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303166737305-Upload-Download) _**💡 Notes**_ > **CLO software** is used to design and create garments in 3D, while **CONNECT** is the marketplace for buying and selling avatars, garments, and digital assets. > **CLO-SET** then brings these assets together into a collaborative workspace for managing, reviewing, sharing, and seamlessly carrying them through merchandising and production. ####
content_description: CLO-SET is your centralized digital workspace for collaborative 3D design, enabling seamless management and sharing of assets throughout the product life cycle.

title: Move Workroom/Style
content: # **Objective** You can move Workroom or Style page to the other Space(Season, Workroom) that you belong to. 1. Instruction 2. Drag & Drop to Child Workroom 3. Drag & Drop to Top Breadcrumb Navigation # **Details** ### 1\. Instruction ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55006285606041)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55006285614361) 1. Put a mouse cursor on the desired Style and click the icon 2. Select the contents you wish to change (multi select content: ctrl/cmd + left mouse button) and click 'Move'. You can select the desired Space(Season, Workroom) that you would like to move to. the Workroom or Style page will be moved accordingly. *You can also move multiple Styles with Multi-Selection (※ Note: Multi-Selection Manual) #### Multi Selection Mouse Navigation **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53461446091673) | Mouse left Button Drag from empty space to select multiple items Ctrl(Cmd) +**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53461446096025)** | Add or remove items from the selection * Mac : Command / Window : Control * Previously selected items will remain selected. * Selecting an already-selected item again will deselect it. Shift + **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53461446096025)** | Select a range of items * adds all items between the most recently selected item and the currently selected item to the selection. ***** Multi-selection is supported **only in the Workroom (Content area)** ### 2) Drag & Drop to Child Workroom * To move the Content into Child Workrooms, simply drag & drop it to the desired Child Workroom * Single or multiple selected contents can be dragged directly into a **Workroom** ![dragdropmove-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262116285081) ### #### ### 3) Drag & Drop to Top Breadcrumb Navigation * Selected contents can be dragged to the **top breadcrumb navigation** * When hovering over a higher-level location, a **“+” indicator** appears, allowing the contents to be dropped and moved. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53461446098073)
content_description: This webpage provides step-by-step instructions for efficiently moving Workroom and Style pages between Spaces using drag-and-drop functionality.

title: Company Setting
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776386673433) Group Admin, Company Admin # **Objective** # **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776379475737)** Company Admin can manage/set Company’s space and customize fields within Company Setting. There are 9 tabs in Company Setting - we will break it down to 5 in terms of usage. 1. General 2. Category / Content - Workflow 3. Content - Information 4. Rendering 5. Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type 6. Trash # **Details** ### 1) General General tab is where you can manage basic profile info and operation of the Company. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776442984345) 1. 1. Change Company name 2. Space Settings: * [Company Library](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191826841) \- a unique Workroom where you can store commonly used Assets throughout the Company * [Line](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) \- an optional space level, between Brand & Season 3. Viewer Settings: turn on/off viewer options * [2D Pattern Viewer](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303154759705) * [Image Viewer](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185843865) 4. Accessible People - you may view the full list of users with access on each Space/Content 5. [Company Transfer](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) \- Transfer the Company from current Group to another 6. Delete Company 7. Change logo color or profile picture for the Company 8. Manage Brands, Line, and Season within the Company ### 2) Category / Content - Workflow Category and Workflow are customizable fields, used to identify/search/filter the Content. ![Category.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776387263641) | | ![Workflow.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776387343897) ---|---|--- * **Category** : can add custom Category up to 4th depth * **Workflow** : can add custom Workflow stage, change name and color chips * Utilizing Category & Workflow * Identify the status of each Content * Filter or Search the Content using Category & Workflow * Quickly view the workflow status from Workroom ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776411956633) --- ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776412153881) ### 3) Content - Information ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55005930830489) * The Content Field is where information about the Content is stored. Users can customize the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Start storing Content information in CLO-SET to elevate your asset management flow. * Content Fields are tailored for each Content Type. Fields used can only be managed by Company Admin and Group Operator. To start adding custom fields, read the instructions below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776380644377) * Before inputting information on the Content, we recommend that you review the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). * To add/edit Content Fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), visit [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873). * Click on 'Content' > 'Information' to view the list of Content Types and Fields used. * Content Fields are shared and applied to all Contents within the [Company](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). #### **1\. Default Fields** * Default Fields can NOT be added or deleted. You can change the name, values, and unit format. * CLO-SET Provides tailored Defaults Fields for each Content Type. * For example, for Style type Contents, there are 6 Default Fields - material composition, customer type, color, price, MOQ, and date. * To edit the name, value, or unit format, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. On the Edit modal, edit the details and click 'Save'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776444124697) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776381090201) ---|--- #### **2\. Custom Fields** * Custom Fields are fully customizable. Can create up to 16 Custom Fields per Content Type. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776396160153) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776444714137) ---|--- * To add a Custom Field, start by clicking the 'Add Custom Field' button. * Fill in the name and select the 'Type' of the field to be used. Fill in values or unit information when applicable, and click 'Save' to create the Custom Field. * Field Types provided are listed below. Once the field is saved, field type **CANNOT** be changed. * Text (up to 100 characters) * Textbox (up to 1000 characters) * Number (in unit format) * Date (in calendar format) * Dropdown: single-selection * Checkbox: multi-selection allowed * To **edit** the Custom Field, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. Changing the field details will impact the existing field information. * To **delete** the Custom Field, hover over the field row and click the trash button. Deleting the field will impact the existing field information, and the data stored will no longer be available. #### **3\. 'Number' Type Fields** **Unit Options** | **Currency Options for Price** | **Unit Format Example** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776389151897) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776389292057) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776429426329) * When editing the 'Number' type fields, you have an option to customize the unit format. * Please refer to the table below for placeholders used to customize the unit format. **Placeholder** | **Explanation** ---|--- 0 | The number of digits. Insignificant zeros are displayed in the result # | The number of digits. Meaningless zeros will not appear in the result . (decimal point) | Format numbers with decimal separators , (rest) | Specifies a thousands separator in a number ### 4) Rendering Add a [Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) to share throughout the Company as a guideline. In Company Settings, you can Add/Change/Delete the Preset file (ZVRP) for your Company. Click on the link to find out more. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776397015961) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776445548697) ---|--- ### 5) Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type Customizable Fields are available for use on [Line Sheet - List Mode](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) to detail each Colorway. Add new fields for your Company, and start utilizing them on Line Sheet. ![Status.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776398996121) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776397606809) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776414449817) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776398032153) ---|---|---|--- * **Status** : Add custom fields to identify the status for each Colorway * Workflow can be set on Content level, and Status can be changed per Colorway on Line Sheet * **Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type** : Add custom fields to use on Line Sheet ![Line_sheet_-_List_Mode_4x.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776399728153) ### 6) Trash Deleted Contents/Workroom/Brand is stored for 30 days on the Trash tab. Company Admin may restore the deleted files by selecting them and clicking on ‘RESTORE’ button. ![Trash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776446586649)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for Company Admins to manage and customize their Company's settings, workflows, and content fields effectively.

title: Category
content: **Objective** Manage the Category of your Content. Customize the field names to match your workflow. 1. What is Category? 2. Category by Content 3. Category Multi-select 4. Category Settings 5. Filter by Category # **Details** ### 1) What is Category? * CLO-SET 'Category' is a customizable field that helps identify the Content, as well as filter the Content for a faster search. * Best Practice: * We recommend using the Category field for unique terms/labels for your team. * ex) 'Basic' line, 'Boyfriend' line, / 'Sunshine Orange', 'Midnight Blue', etc. * For generic terms, CLO-SET [AI-Search](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303182799641) will detect it for you. ![check+shirring+back+womens+swimsuit_Colorway](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777988210841) | ► | ![cat:tag2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778003660185) ---|---|--- ### 2) Category by Content * Identify the Category of each Content. * Editors or above can make changes. * Fields are customizable by Company Admin or above in [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. ![Screenshot 2023-10-24 at 9.46.09 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777988508185) ### 3) Category Multi-select (Bulk Edit Category) * In your Workroom, select the Content(s). * From the multi selection bar above, click 'Category' (multi select content: ctrl/cmd + left mouse button) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55005025128345) * Select the Category to be applied to selected Contents.* * Please note that the pre-existing categories of each Content will be overwritten. ![Screenshot 2023-10-20 at 9.55.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777974212633) ### 4) Category Settings * Category fields are customizable in [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. * You may add up to 4 depths of Category. ![Category.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778004362649) * The **View Options** toggle in the Category tab allows to choose between two display modes for how category information appears on the Content Page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576304797849) 1. Last Depth (Default) Displays only the final (deepest) category level selected for the content. This option keeps the category display concise and minimal. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52952048613785) 2\. Full Depth Displays the entire hierarchy of the selected category—from the top level to the final depth—within the Content Page information. This option provides full visibility into the category structure. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52952002283033) ### 5) Filter by Category ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.16.15 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777974559001) ![Screenshot 2023-10-24 at 11.38.57 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778004637977) Search faster by filtering the Category. Filters are available on the [Search tab](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161) OR in [Workrooms](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54999956371097)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54999972978713) Select the Category filter and choose categories to search. You can use AND or OR conditions: * AND: Includes content with both “A” and “B” * OR: Includes content with either “A” or “B”
content_description: This web page provides guidance on effectively managing and customizing content categories to streamline workflows and enhance content organization and searchability.
